svg.title: RP2 to RP3 outcome-flip matrix
svg.desc: Per-variant matrix over the MVP RP2/RP3 results. The skill, task, instructions, workspace, and contract are hash-pinned and only the runtime profile changes. Each row reports RP2 realized violations and canary observations against RP3 attempted overreach, missing outputs, and canary observations, then labels the resulting outcome flip. Containment cells are config-entailed; the utility-cost and no-drift residual cells are the contribution. Pairwise disagreement is not prevalence.
svg.text: Same skill, different security outcome: RP2 (local agent) → RP3 (Docker sandbox)
The skill, task, instructions, workspace, and contract are hash-pinned; only the runtime profile changes.
No drift: sandbox did not help
No drift: sandbox did not help
No drift: sandbox did not help
3 contained-with-utility-cost · 2 no-drift (sandbox did not help) · 20 canary observations prevented by RP3
Boundary: existing MVP results, RP2/RP3 only; ○ = negative control; pairwise disagreement is not prevalence.
Containment cells are partly entailed by the RP3 profile and labeled as such; mcp-tool-workflow is a scripted profile-conditioned fixture, not runtime-enforced MCP policy.
